definitions.explanation: A recurring fee paid each month for membership in an organization, gym, club, or subscription service.

examples.japanese: {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三千|さんぜん}→三千：00985_sanzen⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧です。
examples.english: The monthly membership fee is 3,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}い→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to pay my gym's monthly fee.

examples.japanese: {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{退会|たいかい}→退会：16082_taikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: The monthly fee was raised, so I'm considering canceling my membership.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used for gym memberships, club dues, and subscription services. The fee is typically paid by automatic bank transfer (⟦{口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ}→口座振替：19853_kouzafurikae⟧) in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay monthly dues)
- {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧／⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (monthly fee is expensive/cheap)
- {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧ (monthly fee increase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年会費|ねんかいひ}→年会費：06414_nenkaihi⟧: annual membership fee — paid once per year
- ⟦{入会金|にゅうかいきん}→入会金：06478_nyuukaikin⟧: enrollment fee — one-time fee to join
